findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done.
Case: normal use - viewing the board after a worker round and before its review.
The added phrase shows effort, but the line still gets its number exclusively from `review_round` (`src/forge/time_records.py:239,388`). Consequently, the second worker run in the new test produces `Round unknown: built at high` (or xhigh), despite recording worker round 2. The board also labels it as having no number (`src/forge/board_app/item.js:115`). Include the known worker-round number in the visible history; the test currently checks only the separate `worker_round` field.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional.
Case: normal use - a split-mode design round falls back after Claude fails before changing the checkout.
`next()` selects the first worker start, including a failed Claude attempt. The supported fallback in `src/forge/worker.py:313–370` then runs Codex in the same round with its own effort. With defaults, the board reports `built at xhigh` from failed Claude although Codex built at high; the final worker timing contains high but is ignored because a start was found. Account for the fallback run rather than presenting the failed attempt's effort as the build effort.
findings.title: Account for the successful fallback worker when selecting effort
